svg.title: ASA Lab 2WD — view from above — 4AA v3
svg.desc: Nonraster SVG. Base and holes aligned to provided drawing; native vector ASA Lab Arduino UNO/AA holder/servo/HC-SR04. All major module bounding boxes measured in millimetres.
svg.metadata: {"createdFor":"ASA Lab 2WD simulator","sourceRepo":"spikeal8-maker/asa-lab","illustrationType":"Top-view mechanical assembly layout; true vector, transparent, no embedded raster","referencePlate":"Платформа.pdf, 05.11.2019, 200 x 80 rear, front flare ~139.4 mm","outlineStatus":"Bézier reconstruction calibrated to supplied PDF; holes and four slots traced from PDF, for simulator preview not toolpath","sourceAssetViews":"Arduino UNO, AA holder, SG90, HC-SR04 are original ASA Lab SVGs. Servo and HC-SR04 are visual sprite projections; they are mounted in 3D in reality.","batteryScaling":"Native SVG displayMm overstated AA diameter; viewport normalized to actual AA 14.5mm / SVG 191px","aaDim":{"diameterMm":14.5,"lengthMm":50.5},"scaledAAHolderMm":{"width":67.49,"height":63.997},"UNOmm":[68.6,53.4],"wheelMm":{"diameter":65,"tread":27,"centerLeft":[92,-54],"centerRight":[92,54]},"drvL298Nmm":[43,43],"positionMm":{"arduino":{"x":79,"y":-34.3,"width":53.4,"height":68.6,"rotationDeg":90},"battery":{"x":134,"y":-29.74,"width":63.997,"height":67.49,"rotationDeg":90},"driver":{"x":33,"y":-21.5,"width":43,"height":43},"servo":{"x":-0.5,"y":-6.1,"width":31.5,"height":12.2,"rotationDeg":90},"sonar":{"x":-4,"y":-22.5,"width":25.305,"height":45,"rotationDeg":-90},"switch":{"x":147.238,"y":-35.012,"width":9.992,"height":5.158}},"batteryOverhangEachSideMm":0,"cautions":["Arduino and L298N assembly board holes must be independently validated before fabrication","The source TT gearmotor SVG is a front view, so physically dimensioned TT gearmotor top projection was drawn for this scene","Front-facing HC-SR04 is represented as a flattened front-view sprite; true 3D top view would show sensor board edge","Switch is shown at one existing PDF slot, but photograph does not determine its real attachment","4AA variant fits on plate under adopted AA size calibration"]}
